_comment: Production configuration for separately owner-authorized Vietnam MPS and Government Office sources.
This is a MANUAL source: public Daily never scrapes the MPS website.
The scheduled private-first collector retains original Vietnamese evidence;
the signed Vietnam Daily handoff admits only independently written English
factual output under an owner-sealed MPS source-use decision and QA.
MOIT, Government News, MOD, other Vietnamese publications and source media

sources.notes: Public Daily does not scrape: bounded official Vietnamese Foreign Affairs originals are collected in authenticated private custody. Only owner-approved, source-pinned, QA-passing, nonverbatim English machine explanations are signed into shared Daily and published. No public original Vietnamese headline/body, full translation, photograph, media, PDF or substantial excerpt. Ministry official claims are attributed, not independent corroboration.

Public Daily retains the bounded bibliographic fallback: first 50 listing entries, at most 15 known-candidate rechecks, verified Government Office issuer. Separately authorized first-party administrative primary PDFs are preserved privately and screened from complete verified text. Source-specific Anthropic and spending gates plus independent factual QA govern short attributed English explanations through the shared Daily. No public original, PDF, full translation, substantial excerpt or media. No complete-archive claim. Policies: config/vietnam_vpcp_metadata_policy.json, config/vietnam_vpcp_text_policy.json and the sealed source-use decision.
